c.v: MSB alignment specifications require WS and SD signals change simultaneously on the falling edge of BCK.
The WS signal is valid until the end of channel data transfer.
The SD signal line transmits the most significant bit of audio data first.
Compared with MSB alignment standard, TDM MSB alignment standard supports multiple channels, see Figure 28.5-2.
